    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),

changed.title: Polynomial circuits recover joint matching counts from moments within each total mismatch count
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ t : ℕ,
  let n := t+1
  let I := Fin n
  let J := Fin (n+1)
  let V := Bool × I
  let P := V → Option Bool
  let S := Fin (2*n+1)
  let W := Fin (4*n+3)
  let hist := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (p : P) (r b : J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,σ i))).card = b.val)).card
  let profile := fun (H : J → J → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (s : S) =>
    ∑ r : J, ∑ b : J, if r.val+b.val = s.val then Nat.choose r.val h * H r b else 0
  let countBits := fun (k : ℕ) (H : J → J → ℕ) =>
    (List.ofFn (fun h : Fin k => (List.ofFn (fun s : S =>
      List.ofFn (fun i : W => (profile H h.val s).testBit i.val))).flatten)).flatten
  let N := fun (known : Bool) => 2 + (if known then n*n+2*n else 0) +
    (if known then 2 else 3)*(2*n+1)*(4*n+3)
  ∀ known : Bool,
    ∃ (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (out : J → J → S → Fin (N known+g.size)),
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N known) g ∧ g.size ≤ (n+2)^C ∧
      (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
        (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
      ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm I) (p : P),
        let perm := (List.ofFn (fun i : I => List.ofFn (fun j : I => decide (σ i = j)))).flatten
        let mask := (List.ofFn (fun i : I => (p (false,i)).isSome)) ++
          List.ofFn (fun i : I => (p (true,i)).isSome)
        let H := hist σ p
        let ws := g.wires ([false,true] ++ (if known then perm ++ mask else []) ++
          countBits (if known then 2 else 3) H)
        ∀ r b : J, (∑ i : S, (ws.getD (out r b i).val false).toNat * 2^i.val) = H r b

changed.title: Simultaneous relative counts for fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions at sizes a fixed fraction below the maximum
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ (estimate : List Bool → List Bool) (degree : Nat), fast estimate ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∀ (g b a : Nat), 1 ≤ g → 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let K := (5*(n+1)^4)^(g+1)
    let eligible := fun s : Nat => 0 < hist s ∧
      (hist (s-1) ≤ K*hist s ∨ ∃ lo hi : Nat,
        0 < hist lo ∧ 0 < hist hi ∧ (∀ j, 0 < hist j → lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi) ∧
        lo ≤ s ∧ s ≤ hi ∧ hi-lo ≤ g*(hi-s))
    let prefixBits := header g ++ header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^(degree*(g+1))
    let sizes := List.finRange (n/2+1)
    ∃ z : (Fin ell → Bool) → Fin (n/2+1) → Nat,
      (∀ tape, estimate (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape) =
        sizes.flatMap (fun s => frame (z tape s))) ∧
      (∀ tape s, z tape s = 0 ↔ hist s.val = 0) ∧
      2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool // ∀ s : Fin (n/2+1), eligible s.val →
        (4*b-4)*hist s.val ≤ z tape s ∧ z tape s ≤ (4*b+4)*hist s.val} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell
changed.unlocks: Gives exact support on every tape and simultaneous relative estimates of signed fitting-function counts below a fractional gap or at a bounded adjacent ratio.
changed.context: Each output integer z represents z/(4b), where b is the unary accuracy parameter. Every tape emits zero exactly at empty sizes. One probability guarantee covers all eligible positive sizes.
changed.sketch: Compile signed samples to a shifted weighted matching histogram. Blossom gives the maximum supported size and the empty matching gives the exact initial count. Sweep the rational activities of the neighboring-mass lemma. Estimate size frequencies from the weighted matching chain. At a grid point where both neighbors are frequent, their ratio divided by the activity estimates the coefficient ratio. Telescope from the initial count. Log concavity puts every earlier ratio within the same cap. Budget relative errors across n ratios and failure over the whole grid. Clip to the exact support.

changed.title: A cut prices the surviving checks on overlapping cyclic products and bounds worst-case prediction leaves
changed.statement:
∀ (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k), 2 ≤ k →
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun n : Nat => (⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (n : Nat) (word : W) (i : Fin k) => word (ix (i.val+k-n % k))
  ∀ (spacing s t : Nat) (name constant : W),
    let out := fun (raw : W) (site : Fin k) =>
      let old := rot s raw + name
      let y := fun u : Fin k =>
        old u + old (ix (u.val+spacing)) + old (ix (u.val+k-spacing % k))
      y site + (1+y (ix (site.val+1)))*y (ix (site.val+2)) + rot t raw site + constant site
    let H := List Bool
    let Tree := Finset H × (H → W →ₗ[F] F) × (H → F) × (H → W →ₗ[F] W) × (H → W)
    let predict : Tree → W → W := fun tree raw =>
      let nodes := tree.1
      let ask := tree.2.1
      let bias := tree.2.2.1
      let aff := tree.2.2.2.1
      let c := tree.2.2.2.2
      let leaf := (List.range nodes.card).foldl (fun (p : H) _ =>
        if p ∈ nodes then p ++ [decide (ask p raw + bias p ≠ 0)] else p) []
      aff leaf raw + c leaf
    let g := Nat.gcd k spacing
    ∀ (sites : Finset (Fin k)) (e : Nat), sites ≠ Finset.univ →
      let E := sites.image (fun i => ix (i.val+1))
      let lane := fun i : Fin k => i.val % g
      let phase := fun i : Fin k => (i.val/g) % 3
      let nxt := fun i : Fin k => ix (i.val+1)
      let prv := fun i : Fin k => ix (i.val+k-1)
      let edges := E.powerset.filter (fun M => ∀ i ∈ M, nxt i ∉ M)
      let mu := edges.sup Finset.card
      let best := edges.filter (fun M => M.card = mu)
      let ends := fun M : Finset (Fin k) => M ∪ M.image nxt
      let adj := fun i j : Fin k => i ∈ E ∧ j = nxt i
      let cs := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).image (fun i =>
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun j =>
          @decide (Relation.EqvGen adj i j) (Classical.propDecidable _) = true))
      let oddCs := cs.filter (fun C => C.card % 2 = 1)
      let eligible := fun C : Finset (Fin k) =>
        if E = Finset.univ then C else C.filter (fun v =>
          ∃ s ∈ C, prv s ∉ E ∧ ((v.val+k-s.val) % k) % 2 = 0)
      let score := fun U : Finset (Fin k) =>
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range g, min 2 (((U.filter (fun v => lane v = j)).image phase).card)
      let deficit := oddCs.powerset.sup (fun T =>
        2*g - ((oddCs.card-T.card) + score (T.biUnion eligible)))
      let D := if 3 ∣ k/g then deficit else 0
      let checks := fun M : Finset (Fin k) => ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun w =>
        (∀ j, j ∉ ends M → w j = 0) ∧ ∀ j : Fin k,
          w j + w (ix (j.val+spacing)) + w (ix (j.val+k-spacing % k)) = 0)).card
      let feasible := fun L : Nat =>
        ∃ tree : Tree, tree.1.card < L ∧ ∀ x : W,
          (sites.filter (fun i => predict tree x i ≠ out x i)).card ≤ e
      IsLeast {z : Nat | ∃ M ∈ best, checks M = z} (2^D) ∧
        feasible (2^(mu-e)) ∧ (∀ L : Nat, feasible L → 2^(mu-e-D) ≤ L) ∧
        (D = 0 → ∀ L : Nat, feasible L ↔ 2^(mu-e) ≤ L) ∧
        ((6 ≤ k ∧ 3 ∣ k ∧ (Nat.Coprime k spacing ∨ (spacing = 2 ∧ 12 ≤ k)) ∧
          E = Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => i.val % 3 ≠ 2)) →
          ∀ L : Nat, feasible L ↔ 2^(k/3-e) ≤ L)

changed.statement:

    let outer := fun c : Finset (Fin n) => (H.filter (fun R => c ⊆ R)).biUnion id \ c
    let left := fun S : Rows => ordinary \ S.biUnion outer
    let reduced := fun S : Rows => base.image (fun R => R ∩ left S)
